invention.ref_zh: 崔寔《四民月令》（公元40年）记载清酱，为酱油早期形态

mass_production.ref_zh: 《齐民要术》（544）给出目前最早的制酱详述

popularization.ref: Term jiangyou becomes established in Song texts
popularization.ref_zh: 宋代文献中「酱油」名称逐渐定型

中国山东（贾思勰《齐民要术》关联地）

sources.title: History of Soy Sauce — Soyinfo Center

summary_zh: 酱油由豆酱汁液演化而来；公元40年《四民月令》已见清酱，544年《齐民要术》详述制法，宋代「酱油」之名定型。
summary_en: Soy sauce evolved from fermented soybean seasonings. Qingjiang appeared in the Simin Yueling (40 CE), the Qimin Yaoshu (544) detailed production, and the name jiangyou settled in Song texts.
